description: `Aspire.Hosting.AppHost.Sdk` is now obsolete (`ASPIRE012`) as the default C# AppHost experience moves to explicit package references, `AddDotnetProject`, and the CLI bundle. The warning is suppressible via `SuppressAspireAppHostSdkObsoleteWarning` or `NoWarn`, and C# templates/`aspire init` now generate projects using the explicit AppHost and Dotnet packages instead of the SDK.
name: Deprecate Aspire.AppHost.Sdk
